title: [SDK-52] [expo-location] Background location permission not working
body:
### Minimal reproducible example

https://<redacted-host>/@brodanoel/background-location-broken

### What platform(s) does this occur on?

iOS

### Where did you reproduce the issue?

in a development build, in Expo Go, in a standalone app

### Summary

The problem, as far as I see, is quite similar to this: https://github.com/expo/expo/issues/25873

Basically, I have to call 2 times `await Location.requestBackgroundPermissionsAsync();` in order to get the permissions.

Note: I'm using SDK 52 with DISABLED NEW ARCH

# Steps to Reproduce

* Open https://<redacted-host>/@brodanoel/background-location-broken
* Tap on "Yes!" blue button
* It will ask you for foreground permissions first. Answer with: "Allow while using app"
* It will ask you for background permissions then. Answer with "Change to Always Allow"
* It will show you an error like if you canceled the permissions.
* Tap again on "Yes!" blue button
* It will show you the information as you would have grated the permissions before

comments.body:
Hi, @reporter - I think what you're doing wrong in the example is that on iOS you only ask for Background location while on Android you ask for foreground first and then background. 

The difference is that on iOS the foreground permission is mapped to asking for `while in use` permission, while background permission is mapped to `alway` which is needed for background location.

Could you try switching to only asking for background (`always`) permission in your iOS app and see if it solves it?

comments.body:
@participant2 seems like there is a bug there.

If I ask for the Foreground permissions first, and then backgorund, the bug still there.

Let me give you more context:

My app can ask permissions in different situations.
There are 2 different features in my app:
- A map which only requires foreground permissions
- A background check, which need a background permissions

The second feature, may never be used by the user.


Lets imagine this situation:
You signup on my app, and uses the map, so I request you only foreground information.
2 months after, you also want to use the background check, so I ask you for background permissions. There, the bug appear, because you already gave me the foreground 2 months before.


In this other situation seems like there are no problems:
You signup in my app, and uses first the background feature, before the map (which never actually happens in my app).
In this case, I ask you first for the background permissions, and then when you want to use the map, I already have the foreground permissions.

So, the solution seem to be: Just always ask for background permissions", but that's incorrect because if the user do not want to use the background check feature, it does not makes sense to ask for backgorund permissions (more then 98% of the users only uses the foreground feature/map)

comments.author: participant2
comments.body:
Hi, @reporter - I believe this is based on a misunderstanding. So on iOS there is no such thing as background or foreground permissions, but historically the `expo-location` package was designed so that we ended up with these two types of permissions. 

When you ask for background permissions through Expo Location on iOS, you ask for location permissions with the `always` type. This is required for background location.

When you ask for foreground permissions through Expo Location you ask for a permission to use locations while the app is in use or once. When the user has accepted this, you can ask for background location "always" and the user is asked to accept to change.

The point with the "clicking 2 times" issue is that you shouldn't call this two methods at the same time on iOS - only the one you need is the correct way to call this.

Hope this makes sense.

comments.body:
> Hi, [@reporter](https://github.com/reporter) - I believe this is based on a misunderstanding. So on iOS there is no such thing as background or foreground permissions, but historically the `expo-location` package was designed so that we ended up with these two types of permissions.
> 
> When you ask for background permissions through Expo Location on iOS, you ask for location permissions with the `always` type. This is required for background location.
> 
> When you ask for foreground permissions through Expo Location you ask for a permission to use locations while the app is in use. When the user has accepted this, there is unfortunately no way on iOS to ask the user to "upgrade" the permissions to `always` - which is needed for background location.
> 
> What other apps are doing in the above scenario, is to ask the user to open Settings and change `when in use` to `always` manually.
> 
> Hope this makes sense.

Thanks for the reply. There’s a misunderstanding on our side as well. I’m working on a delivery app for drivers. When a user logs in, we request foreground location permission. When the driver switches status to online, we request background location permission. So these two permission requests don’t happen simultaneously, and the user can reject background permission. In that case, we use foreground location updates. After upgrading to expo SDK 52 background location permission returns “denied” without waiting for a user’s response.
